name: z-codex-router
description: A local, fail-closed router policy for Codex tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Install, enable, recover, and remove a safe task router.
interface.longDescription: Install and enable, inspect, recover, safely upgrade, or cleanly remove a portable global routing policy for Codex.
capabilities: Parent-owned route receipts and tri-state runtime verification
defaultPrompt: Install and enable Z Codex Router globally.
Check my Z Codex Router installation.
Validate a parent-owned route receipt and runtime observability boundary.
Show or validate my Z Codex Router effective profile mapping; initialize, set, reset, or restore an override only when I explicitly request it, using a managed backup rather than a manual overwrite.
When desktop policy requires an explicit new task before create_thread, stop with ROUTE_HANDOFF_REQUIRED and return the direct receipt-preserving new-task command; never fall back to spawn_agent.
Only when I explicitly ask, enable, check, or restore Z Codex Router's safe-auto approval policy without widening its sandbox or human-authorization boundary.
Safely recover Z Codex Router after a failed action.
Safely disable and uninstall Z Codex Router.
